fields.features_heading: What the Door Crew Needs Before Anyone Enters
fields.features_subheading: Emergent builds the waiver, the guardian and contact sections, and the tablet your door crew searches on a busy night.
fields.feature_1:
A QR code that opens the waiver in line

Print the code on a sign halfway down the queue. Guests sign on their own phones while they wait, and nobody holds up the door with a clipboard, a pen, and a stack of paper.
fields.feature_2:
Guardian signatures for anyone under 18

When the birth date puts a guest under 18, the form asks a parent or guardian to sign in their own name. Both signatures sit on the guest's record for the door check.
fields.feature_3:
Contact clauses only for guests who opt in

Guests choose the standard route or the contact route. Choosing contact adds clauses to initial, one for each kind of contact, and asks for a safe word that ends the scene.
fields.feature_4:
A list of the strobes, fog and loud sound

List the effects inside the attraction, such as strobe lights, fog, and sudden loud noise. Each guest ticks a box to confirm reading them, and can leave a note for staff.
fields.feature_5:
A door tablet that searches by last name

Door staff type a last name and see every guest in the party marked Signed with the time, or Waiting. Anyone still Waiting signs on the spot from the same QR code on their phone.
fields.feature_6:
Export the code to your own repository

On paid plans, export the full code to your GitHub repository and host the waiver app wherever your ticketing runs. Keep changing it by prompt, or hand it to a developer.

fields.usecase_heading: The Waiver at Four Different Haunts
fields.tab_content_1:
Six friends signed in line, all six on file at 8:14 PM

Kristof Moravec's party of six joins the queue at Gallowmoor Scare Farm on a Saturday night. Each friend scans the QR code on the queue sign and signs on their own phone. At the door, gate lead Pelagia Zelenka types Moravec into the tablet. All six names read Signed, the last one at 8:14 PM.
fields.tab_content_2:
Nyssa, 15, goes in after her mother signs as guardian

Nyssa Delacorte is 15 and in line for the Crowsend Fire Company haunted barn. Her date of birth opens a guardian section on the form. Her mother, Iolanthe Delacorte, signs it on the same phone in her own name. The door tablet shows Nyssa as Signed with a Guardian signed tag, and both signatures sit on her record.
fields.tab_content_3:
Opting into contact adds three clauses and a safe word

Guests at The Cinder Mill pick a route at the ticket window. Dragomir Sundqvist picks contact, so his waiver adds three clauses to initial, the first one allowing actors to touch him. He initials each and sets Lanterns as his safe word. His record tells the door crew to hand him a red glow necklace.
fields.tab_content_4:
Her waiver from 8:47 PM, with the incident note on it

A guest twisted an ankle at the hay-bale exit of Duskhollow Corn Maze at 9:30 PM. Operations manager Lettice Benedek searches Brisbois on the office tablet and opens Oriel Brisbois's waiver, signed at 8:47 PM on version 3 of the wording. She adds an incident note, which stays attached to that waiver.

plan.angle: Searchers for haunted house waiver form find template sites that stop at the wording and leave the operator with clipboards at the ticket booth. This page shows the form working on a busy night: a group of six signing from a QR code in the queue, a 15-year-old whose date of birth opens a guardian section, a contact haunt where opting in adds clauses to initial and a safe word, and an operations manager pulling up one guest's signed waiver after a twisted ankle. Release wording goes to an attorney licensed in the operator's state; the form records who signed which version and when.
tab_stories: At Gallowmoor Scare Farm, Kristof Moravec's party of 6 scans the QR code on the queue sign, all 6 sign on their phones before the door, and gate lead Pelagia Zelenka's tablet shows 6 of 6 signed at 8:14 PM.
At the Crowsend Fire Company haunted barn, Nyssa Delacorte, 15, enters her date of birth, a guardian section opens, and her mother Iolanthe Delacorte signs it in her own name before the door.
At The Cinder Mill, Dragomir Sundqvist opts into the contact route, initials 3 contact clauses, sets the safe word Lanterns, and his record tells the door crew to hand him a red glow necklace.

At Duskhollow Corn Maze, operations manager Lettice Benedek searches Brisbois after a twisted ankle at the hay-bale exit, opens Oriel Brisbois's waiver signed at 8:47 PM on wording version 3, and adds an incident note.
